title: Rohingya Mass Influx into Bangladesh
subtitle: Violence in Myanmar drove one of the fastest refugee influxes in recent South Asian history.
summary: From late August 2017, large numbers of Rohingya fled Myanmar's Rakhine State into Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh. The influx rapidly became a major humanitarian emergency involving the Bangladesh government, UN agencies, and international aid networks.
heroTagline: Violence in Myanmar drove one of the fastest refugee influxes in recent South Asian history.
whyItMatters: The 2017 influx reshaped Bangladesh's humanitarian policy, border politics, and long-term regional diplomacy.
